title: notification-dispatch-node
blurb: Extend a working FIFO notification queue with scheduled delivery and stable urgency ordering.
brief:
A working FIFO notification queue needs two new capabilities: future delivery times and urgency levels. The current extension ranks everything immediately, so a future urgent notification can jump ahead of ready work.

Read the built-in `node:test` contract before editing `src/queue.js`. Time is supplied to `take(now)`; do not read the wall clock.

**Your job:** choose only eligible notifications, rank them stably, and preserve the original FIFO behavior.
